column1: # Process inputs of the worker SDK, P/03; not a new executable or CLI. UTF-8, LF, literal TAB, no CSV quoting.
# Names: $NAME is an environment value, <name> is the optional ordinary worker slot-name argument. commands: worker,domainworker.
# Types are the P/01 vocabulary plus string.
# default holds only a literal default. With default=- and default_text!=- the default is a rule of the linked norm, to be resolved by the adapter, not a literal word.
# No row makes the optional library argument compulsory. A manifest-defined slot.name_env is dynamic: the adapter reads that declared name only when <name> is absent.
# The adapter resolves external/default inputs and validates the referenced contracts: instance/box, label-list, store/object address, capacity, role, manifest rev, paths.
# An empty bad cell adds no CEL check; it does NOT remove the checks of norm or grant permission to accept a malformed input.
# W2C_ROLE is mandatory for the launcher route and equals <sub>worker/<sub>domain; direct SDK start is not a new w2c-run route.
# The launcher parses environment files (P/02.4); the SDK consumes its resulting environment. W2C_ENV/W2C_SUB_ENV are not read recursively.
# f contains values as given, before alias defaults: aliases both given with unequal bytes refuse; resolve one value before applying the default.
#var f map<string,dyn> — the process inputs keyed by their exact name; all rows here have string values
